security_implications: This chunk synchronizes the life‑cycle escalation enable (lc_escalate_en_i) through prim_lc_sync. A failure in the synchronizer (e.g., due to invalid NumLcSyncCopies or metastability) can cause incorrect escalation handling, potentially allowing a security‑critical state to persist without a forced shutdown. Additionally, en_masking_o is statically tied to the EnMasking parameter; if masking is inadvertently disabled, intermediate values (including secret key material) could leak via side‑channel attacks. Both pathways directly impact the confidentiality and integrity of the KMAC security boundary.
